release_notes:
New Pro feature: dynamic variables in snippets.

- {{date}}, {{time}} and {{datetime}} insert the current local date and time. Add an offset such as {{date+7d}}, {{date-2w}}, {{time+30m}} or {{time+2h}}.

- {{clipboard}} inserts your current clipboard text, and {{cursor}} places the text cursor where you want to continue typing.

- Choose date and time formats in Settings, or give one variable its own format, e.g. {{date:dd.MM.yyyy}}.

- The snippet editor highlights variables, offers an Insert variable menu and shows a live preview of the expanded text.

Variables are resolved locally on your PC. Without Pro they are typed exactly as written.
